BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain gripper-strips)
  (:requirements :typing)
  (:types robot gripper room object)
  (:predicates 
    (at-robby ?r - robot ?ro - room)
    (at ?o - object ?ro - room)
    (free ?r - robot ?g - gripper)
    (carry ?r - robot ?o - object ?g - gripper)
  )

  (:action move
    :parameters (?r - robot ?from - room ?to - room)
    :precondition (at-robby ?r ?from)
    :effect (and (at-robby ?r ?to)
                 (not (at-robby ?r ?from)))
  )

  (:action pick
    :parameters (?r - robot ?o - object ?ro - room ?g - gripper)
    :precondition (and (at ?o ?ro)
                       (at-robby ?r ?ro)
                       (free ?r ?g))
    :effect (and (carry ?r ?o ?g)
                 (not (at ?o ?ro))
                 (not (free ?r ?g)))
  )

  (:action drop
    :parameters (?r - robot ?o - object ?ro - room ?g - gripper)
    :precondition (and (carry ?r ?o ?g)
                       (at-robby ?r ?ro))
    :effect (and (at ?o ?ro)
                 (free ?r ?g)
                 (not (carry ?r ?o ?g)))
  )
)
END DOMAIN
